Issue 19:
# 19 — Extract normaliseProduct to products lib

Status: needs-triage
Type: AFK

## What to build

`MostLoved.jsx` manually remaps DB view fields (`product_id → id`, `product_name → name`) before passing data to `ProductCard`. This transform is invisible at `ProductCard`'s interface — if the view changes, components break silently. Extract a `normaliseProduct(row)` function to `src/lib/products.js` so every caller uses the same shape contract.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `src/lib/products.js` exists and exports `normaliseProduct(row)` that maps the `most_loved_products` view row shape to the `ProductCard` expected shape (`{ id, name, description, price, image_url, tags, is_available }`)
- [ ] `MostLoved.jsx` uses `normaliseProduct` instead of inline field mapping
- [ ] `ProductCard.jsx` has a JSDoc comment documenting the expected product shape
- [ ] Unit tests for `normaliseProduct` cover: full row mapping, missing optional fields default gracefully
- [ ] No existing tests broken

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately.

plan.sprint_goal: Extract normaliseProduct to src/lib/products.js, use it in MostLoved.jsx, document ProductCard's expected shape, and add unit tests covering full mapping and missing optional fields.

dev1.task: 1) Create src/lib/products.js and export normaliseProduct(row) that maps most_loved_products view row fields (product_id→id, product_name→name, plus description, price, image_url, tags, is_available with safe defaults for missing optional fields). 2) Update MostLoved.jsx to import and use normaliseProduct instead of any inline field remapping. 3) Add a JSDoc comment to ProductCard.jsx documenting the expected product prop shape: { id, name, description, price, image_url, tags, is_available }.
dev1.context_needed: Current MostLoved.jsx inline mapping logic (the fields it maps from the most_loved_products view row to ProductCard props). ProductCard.jsx prop usage to confirm the exact expected shape. The most_loved_products view schema from supabase/migrations/004_most_loved_view.sql to know all source column names.

dev2.task: Write unit tests for normaliseProduct in src/lib/products.test.js covering: (a) full row mapping — all fields present maps correctly to { id, name, description, price, image_url, tags, is_available }, (b) missing optional fields (description, tags, image_url) default gracefully (e.g. empty string / empty array / null rather than throwing), (c) ensure no existing tests in MostLoved.test.jsx or elsewhere are broken by the refactor (run the full test suite and fix any import/shape breakages). Also perform a code review of Dev1's normaliseProduct implementation checking for edge cases (null row, extra unknown fields passed through or dropped cleanly).
dev2.context_needed: The most_loved_products view column names from supabase/migrations/004_most_loved_view.sql. ProductCard.jsx expected prop shape. MostLoved.test.jsx to understand existing test assumptions that must not regress. The test setup file at src/test/setup.js for any global mocks.

plan.shared_types: most_loved_products view row shape (input): { product_id: string, product_name: string, description?: string, price: number, image_url?: string, tags?: string[], is_available?: boolean, total_sold?: number }. normaliseProduct output shape (= ProductCard expected props): { id: string, name: string, description: string, price: number, image_url: string | null, tags: string[], is_available: boolean }. Both devs must agree on defaults for missing optional fields before coding: description defaults to '', tags defaults to [], image_url defaults to null, is_available defaults to true.
